summary: Fresno County lookout site built 1934 on Stag Dome, a Plan R1 cabin on a short timber pole; removal date unknown and no source describes lookout remains.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register gives 1934. The californialookouts listing shows 1933 beside the site name without saying what that year marks. The record keeps 1934 from the register and notes the listing's 1933.

The register lists Sierra National Forest and Fresno County. Bob Burd's 2018 trip report places the summit on the boundary of Kings Canyon National Park and Sequoia National Forest. The record keeps the register's agency and flags the boundary conflict.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: one register entry, one listing with an unexplained 1933, and one 2018 trip report that mentions no lookout remains. Staffing, fires and removal date are not in any source read, so none are stated. The register's 'Stag Dome Lookout - courtesy of Viola Parker' photo was not downloaded. Brief elevation (2328.7 m) matches the register's 2,329 m. Agency and boundary conflict left for the editor. The brief's access 'unknown' was replaced by 'public' from the 2018 trip report; no closure found, but the visit is a single 2018 account, so an editor may want to downgrade it. Web searches found no further lookout history.
